moments.title: US Open Finals Loom
moments.blurb: The US Open tennis tournament, which began its main draw on August 30th, is heading into its final week, with the women's singles final on September 12th and the men's on September 13th.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Who are you backing for the US Open titles? The final weekend is just around the corner!

angles.name: British Hopes
angles.copy: As the US Open heats up, are any British players making a deep run in New York? Fingers crossed for a UK champion!

angles.name: Race Weekend Excitement

angles.name: Team Focus
angles.copy: Monza, the Temple of Speed! Will Ferrari deliver in front of the Tifosi, or can another team spoil the party?

moments.title: Strictly Pre-Record Day
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing's 24th series launch show is being pre-recorded on September 9th, ahead of its broadcast on September 19th, with live shows starting on September 26th.

angles.name: Strictly Buzz

angles.name: New Hosts Tease
angles.copy: With new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe, Strictly is getting a refresh! Excitement building for the pre-record happening today.

moments.title: Hello, Meteorological Autumn!
moments.blurb: September 1st marks the beginning of meteorological autumn in the UK, bringing cooler weather and changing leaves.

angles.name: Autumnal Vibes
angles.copy: Out with the summer sun, in with the pumpkin spice! Meteorological Autumn officially begins on Tuesday. What's your favourite thing about the season?

angles.name: Weather Watch
angles.copy: Crisper mornings and cosy evenings are on the horizon. Meteorological Autumn kicks off on Tuesday – time to dig out those jumpers!
